TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD294C INSTALLED WI 1.6NM RADIUS OF
523719N 0011409E (UNIVERSITY OF EAST ANGLIA, NORWICH). BEYOND
VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA.
MAX HGT 400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC
CAT VLOS UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL
OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION
ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS
ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3
REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. 
FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2025-8708/16.
